clock.created_at_semantics: official help: date and time report was created; participant receipt unobserved
clock.operational_pd_clock: Official May1,2025 training section5.2: PD starts20:00 EST, hourly shrinking look-ahead until next20:00 cycle
clock.delivery_clock: Hour-ending1..24 in native market EST; keep CreatedAt raw and clock-convention field separately
clock.created_at_to_EST_mapping: Operating-clock-consistent interpretation, not explicit timezone encoding in XML. Require a disclosed convention and sensitivity; do not call it verified participant availability.

horizon.predispatch: Native hourly, varying remaining-current-day/next-day look-ahead. Each probed date report has24 hourly slots, including already delivered slots in late versions; filter by information cutoff and delivery interval start.
horizon.realtime: 12 five-minute interval nodes in current dispatch hour, nullable values and administrative flags; completed interval prices are labels, never forecast inputs.
